q: In 1905, German physicist _____ proposed that light, considered a form of electromagnetic waves, must also be thought of as particle or photon.
e: In 1905, German physicist Albert Einstein proposed that light, considered a form of electromagnetic waves, must also be thought of as particle or photon. Put Louis de Broglie or Niels Bohr in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics. Einstein's 1905 photon is the particle side of light, energy hf.

q: In 1923, French physicist Louis de Broglie extended the idea of the wave-particle duality and proposed that the wavelength of a material particle would be related to its _____.
e: In 1923, French physicist Louis de Broglie extended the idea of the wave-particle duality and proposed that the wavelength of a material particle would be related to its momentum. mass is not momentum, and charge is not momentum either. de Broglie wavelength is h over momentum; every moving particle carries a wave.

q: The wavelength $\lambda$ associated with a moving particle (matter wave) is also called _____ wavelength.
e: The wavelength λ associated with a moving particle (matter wave) is also called de Broglie wavelength. Compton and Planck belong to other processes, not this de Broglie case. de Broglie wavelength is h over momentum; every moving particle carries a wave.

q: If a particle is moving with a velocity $v$, the momentum $p=mv$ and its de Broglie wavelength $\lambda$ is equal to _____.
e: If a particle is moving with a velocity v, the momentum p=mv and its de Broglie wavelength λ is equal to h/mv. Put mv/h or h v in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics. de Broglie wavelength is h over momentum; every moving particle carries a wave.

q: All moving particles exhibit properties of both particles and _____ nature.
e: All moving particles exhibit properties of both particles and wave nature. Put magnetic or chemical in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics. All moving particles exhibit properties of both particles and _____ nature. wave.

q: Momentum $p$ relates kinetic energy $KE$ of the particle as follows: $KE =$ _____.
e: Momentum p relates kinetic energy KE of the particle as follows: KE = p^2 / 2m. 2m / p^2 is not p^2 / 2m, and p / 2m is not p^2 / 2m either. The value 2m is the figure this statement is using.

q: The de Broglie wavelength of a particle in terms of its kinetic energy $KE$ is expressed as $\lambda =$ _____.
e: The de Broglie wavelength of a particle in terms of its kinetic energy KE is expressed as λ = h/sqrt2mKE. Put h/2mKE or sqrt2mKE/h in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics. de Broglie wavelength is h over momentum; every moving particle carries a wave.

q: The existence of matter waves were first experimentally confirmed by Thomson's cathode ray diffraction experiment and the _____ experiment for electrons.
e: The existence of matter waves were first experimentally confirmed by Thomson's cathode ray diffraction experiment and the Davisson-Germer experiment for electrons. Put Michelson-Morley or Rutherford in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics. In metals the mobile carriers are electrons, drifting opposite the conventional-current arrow.

q: Furthermore, neutral atoms and even molecules have been shown to be _____-like.
e: Furthermore, neutral atoms and even molecules have been shown to be wave-like. Put solid or particle in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics. Furthermore, neutral atoms and even molecules have been shown to be _____-like. wave.

q: In an electron microscope, the _____ nature of electrons is used instead of light.
e: In an electron microscope, the wave nature of electrons is used instead of light. Put particle or magnetic in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics. In metals the mobile carriers are electrons, drifting opposite the conventional-current arrow.

q: Bohr's second postulate of hydrogen atom states that an integral number of de Broglie wavelengths associated with a revolving electron must fit in the _____ of an orbit.
e: Bohr's second postulate of hydrogen atom states that an integral number of de Broglie wavelengths associated with a revolving electron must fit in the circumference of an orbit. radius is not circumference, and area is not circumference either. Bohr's second postulate sets mvr = nℏ, so angular momentum is quantized. In metals the mobile carriers are electrons, drifting opposite the conventional-current arrow.

q: According to de Broglie hypothesis, the angular momentum of the orbiting electron is _____.
e: According to de Broglie hypothesis, the angular momentum of the orbiting electron is quantized. Put continuous or zero in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics. de Broglie wavelength is h over momentum; every moving particle carries a wave.

q: 1 eV (electron volt) is the energy gained by an electron when accelerated through a potential of one _____.
e: 1 eV (electron volt) is the energy gained by an electron when accelerated through a potential of one volt. ampere and ohm belong to other processes, not this volt case. In metals the mobile carriers are electrons, drifting opposite the conventional-current arrow.

q: The de Broglie wavelength for a macroscopic particle like a basketball is very much shorter than those of an electron, hence wave nature cannot be _____ for a basketball.
e: The de Broglie wavelength for a macroscopic particle like a basketball is very much shorter than those of an electron, hence wave nature cannot be observed for a basketball. calculated is not observed, and ignored is not observed either. de Broglie wavelength is h over momentum; every moving particle carries a wave.
